$comment: Mirror of the MCP tool schemas for non-MCP clients (e.g. OpenAI-style function calling). The MCP server is the source of truth.

tools.name: keyboard_status
tools.description: Return the current BLE link state: READY, CONNECTED_NOT_READY, or DISCONNECTED.

tools.name: keyboard_wait_ready
tools.description: Block until the keyboard is READY (host subscribed) or timeout.

tools.name: keyboard_type
tools.description: Type a string on the target machine. Set press_enter=true to append Enter.

tools.name: keyboard_combo
tools.description: Press a modifier combo, e.g. CTRL+C, WIN+R, CTRL+SHIFT+T. Modifiers: CTRL SHIFT ALT WIN (alias GUI).

tools.name: keyboard_pair
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: clear all bonds and re-advertise for fresh pairing. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: mouse_status
tools.description: Return the current mouse BLE link state: READY, CONNECTED_NOT_READY, or DISCONNECTED.

tools.name: mouse_wait_ready
tools.description: Block until the mouse is READY (host subscribed) or timeout.

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move the pointer by a RELATIVE offset in pixels (+dx = right, +dy = down). No absolute coordinates.

tools.name: mouse_button_down
tools.description: Press and hold a button (start a drag). Pair with mouse_button_up.

tools.name: mouse_button_up
tools.description: Release a held button (end a drag).

tools.name: mouse_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the vertical wheel. Positive = up, negative = down.

tools.name: mouse_release
tools.description: Release all currently held mouse buttons.

tools.name: mouse_pair
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: clear all bonds and re-advertise for fresh pairing. Requires confirm=true.
